Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: high fidelity Rakky Ride mobile app design proposal for approval only. Clean white-forward app, forest green primary #176B17, pale mint #EAF5E5, silver #EEF1EC, charcoal text #141A14, fine silver borders, amber caution and red cancellation/financial debits. Compact typography: at a 403px logical screen body 13px, labels 13px, header 15px medium, monetary hero 24px maximum. Conventional thin consistent outline utility icons 16–18px, small generic car icon, not emojis, no huge illustrations. Airy precise alignment without oversized padding. Realistic usable mobile UI, all text sharp legible. All sample information below is fictional. No map on these history/receipt pages, no device hardware frame, no decorative background patterns or gradients. Match the supplied existing rider design reference's card/date/route hierarchy, adapted for drivers. Do not copy any original reference numbers mechanically. No fabricated features like tips, ratings, download, share, or charts.
Primary request: generate ONE portrait mobile screen, approximately 403 x 850 logical pixels rendered at high resolution, a beautiful compact DRIVER trip history matching the existing rider history. Top status bar and narrow header with circular back control and title "Driver trips". Under header one low-height mint shortcut row: small coins icon, "Earnings breakdown", right chevron. No aggregate earnings totals. Three equal compact filter pills "All", "Completed", "Not completed"; All is forest green with white text. Content grouped by dates, separated compact bordered white trip cards, thin green outlined conventional car glyph in mint 30px square or tiny package icon. Each card header time left and textual status pill right. Pickup and destination on distinct small-text rows connected by a thin route line with circle/pin. Footer hairline left shows payment icon and "Cash · View receipt" or "Wallet · View receipt"; right stacked tiny grey label "Your earnings" above small bold green amount. These are driver net amounts after commission, not gross fares. Show:
date heading "Today · 21 Oct"
card1 time "11:42 AM", green "Completed", route "Allen Avenue, Ikeja" / "Ikeja City Mall, Alausa", footer "Cash · View receipt", earnings "₦4,080".
card2 time "9:18 AM", green "Completed", route "Admiralty Way, Lekki" / "The Palms, Lekki", footer "Wallet · View receipt", earnings "₦3,570".
date heading "Yesterday · 20 Oct"
card3 time "5:20 PM", red "Cancelled", route "Yaba, Lagos" / "Maryland Mall", footer green "View details" left, muted "Trip cancelled" right. Do NOT show a price or earnings for cancelled trip.
card4 time "2:10 PM", tiny package glyph, green "Delivered", route "Surulere, Lagos" / "Ilupeju, Lagos", footer "Wallet · View receipt", earnings "₦2,550".
At bottom small full width green outline button "Load older trips" and unobstructed bottom safe area. Fit all four cards entirely, make text and glyphs compact. Polished complete page, no clipping.

Both are the proposed DRIVER trip receipt; demonstrate the distinction between a Cash trip and a Wallet trip. Labels outside screens "Cash trip" and "Wallet trip", restrained 15px. Each entire screen visible with generous separation. Same thin borders, white background, green-mint highlights as supplied rider receipt. Compact top status bar, 44px circular back control and 15px title "Trip receipt". Date small muted "21 Oct 2026 · 11:42 AM". Mint summary card has small car glyph on left with fine vertical divider, right green "Completed" badge, label "Your earnings", green bold "₦4,080", tiny subline "Cash trip" on left screen, "Wallet trip" on right.
Then bordered compact route card with pickup/destination labels and separate address lines: "Allen Avenue, Ikeja", "Ikeja City Mall, Alausa". Below a short horizontal two-column strip "Est. distance" "12.5 km" and "Est. duration" "28 min".
Then bordered white card header "Earnings breakdown"; three right-aligned-value rows "Trip fare" "₦4,800", "Commission" "−₦720" (debit red), hairline then bold "Your earnings" "₦4,080" (green).
Below small silver settlement block with money/wallet icon:
LEFT CASH: title "Cash payment"; two rows "Fare collected in cash" "₦4,800" and "Wallet commission" "−₦720" red. Small muted explanatory line "Keep the cash fare. Commission is charged to your wallet." Do not label ₦4,080 as cash received or wallet credited.
RIGHT WALLET: title "Wallet payment"; row "Credited to your wallet" "+₦4,080" green. Tiny line "Your earnings are added after commission."
Below compact bordered details card rows with tiny outline icons "Rider" "Alex O." and "Trip ID" "7f3a9c12-2241-4b02-a104-00aa3378a918" wrapping fully into two lines, no ellipsis. This is fictional.
Bottom small green text action "Help & support" with help icon and clear safe area. Fit entire screens, avoid big type or tall cards. No driver name/vehicle self-summary, no rider phone, no extra fee/tip rows. These are sample settled trip states, not pending payments.
